subject: How to generate different velocities for same structure during equilibration

messages.author: Sadaf Rani
messages.body:
Dear Amber
I have performed a simulation and in order to know the consistency for
fluctuations I want to run a duplicate of it.
In the first simulation; I slowly equilibrated the system starting from
temp0=0 and moving towards 300 in steps using random seed ig=-1
and gamma_ln=1.
Now for the second run should I use the same minimized structure and just
change the random seed number value? How should I deal with temperature
settings?
Could anyone please give your expert opinion?
Sadaf

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
if tempi=0, there are no initial velocities assigned (0 Kelvon). if
tempi>0 and velocities are not read from the inpcrd, using a different
random seed will give you different initial velocities.
